natural_language_by_interaction.full: Load the ember crate and wake the lifts. Carry it across the replayed lift stacks. Drag the courier in the overhead chart toward an intended landing spot and release to hop. E burns the crate. full.summary: Drag the courier on the overhead aim chart and release to set a ballistic velocity; E burns the carried crate. Sparse drags and pointer capture are supported. In either mode, click a top marked SURVEY ? to inspect its motor survey; discovered rails stay retained.

simplified.summary: Click the courier then any chart position to set the same ballistic velocity; CANCEL AIM replaces Escape and BURN CRATE replaces E. No automatic interception or targeting by object identity. In either mode, click a top marked SURVEY ? to inspect its motor survey; discovered rails stay retained.
